q1 criteria:

Instructions: How should documented members be classified w.r.t original versus SMBB biomass-burning forcing protocol? Select exactly one option. Use other only when answer outside substantive alternatives. Use not_stated missing etc. Use conflicting only unresolved incompatible evidence.

Evidence: LENS2 has two 50-member halves: original biomass-burning forcing and SMBB affecting 1990-2020. At four macro-init dates, first ten micro-perturbation members use original forcing, second ten use SMBB. Ten additional even-decade initializations use original; ten odd-decade use SMBB. Records align. So all 100 members: 50 original, 50 SMBB. Collection contains members using each of two protocols. So q1 = two_protocol_groups. Need ensure no conflicting. Source faithful adaptation. yes.

- initialization_only: No forcing or code difference is present; only initial conditions differ.
- not_stated: evidence doesn't establish.
- smoothing_only: Yes; the two halves differ only in biomass-burning smoothing operation.

Question: Does the documented difference between these halves isolate biomass-burning smoothing as the only implementation change? Evidence: Remaining modification paragraphs: The SMBB implementation also corrects emission-dataset issues and changes timing of crop-harvest carbon-flux term. Additional output fields also differ. So no, SMBB half also incorporates other changes. Therefore bundled_changes. Note says project reports no significant solution changes from former corrections etc but still implementation changes. So answer bundled_changes.
